verdicts.evidence: lines 586-587, 596: Find rooms and Try again call search(), Book room calls book(); line 546: 'Book another room' link gets a real href back to the empty form. No control without a handler.

lines 376, 417-430: rooms rendered from api.findRooms; lines 502, 527-545: confirmation built from the createBooking response; lines 394-396: empty result says no rooms are free. No hardcoded records or placeholder text.
line 448: summary above Book room shows room, floor, date, time range and people; line 400: count line restates the criteria; search form stays visible above the results (lines 144-177).

lines 392, 450, 565-570: criteria and room kept in the URL and restored on reload; lines 465-474, 597-599: title, note, catering saved to sessionStorage on input; failures leave fields untouched (503-514). Criteria of a never-successful search are not persisted.

line 196: catering unchecked by default; lines 316-327: default date and time are the next future half hour; line 407: preselected room is the smallest that fits. No dialogs; Enter only submits the visible form.
lines 143-209: search, room choice, details and Book room are all on one screen with no dialog or second page; the confirmation replaces the view after booking (527-552).

lines 141-214: only the when/duration/people form, free rooms list, meeting title, catering, reception note, summary, Book room and the booked confirmation. Each maps to a task in the brief; no extra panels.

line 176: Find rooms is primary; line 409 removes its primary class when results show so only Book room (line 205) is primary; line 359 restores it when results clear. Try again (line 182) is secondary.
No action deletes, overwrites or is irreversible; the only actions are Find rooms, Try again and Book room (lines 176, 182, 205).

lines 438-447: catering checkbox is disabled when the room has no catering and the note beside it (line 197) reads '<room> has no catering. Free with catering: ...'. Buttons are aria-disabled only during their own request (351, 479).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (lines 141-213, 334-340, 373, 385, 395, 400, 442-448, 499, 510-512, 530-537) concern the booking task; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the request.

lines 442-443: catering note sits under the catering checkbox and decides room or catering choice; line 460: 'Search changed. Find rooms to update the list.' sits under the Find rooms button. No other notes or banners.
No introductory or narrating prose (lines 141-209). The only guidance is one short line at the control: line 460 under Find rooms and the next-step half of the empty and error messages (395, 510).

No subtitles or field helper text (lines 146-202). Line 400 count line adds count and criteria to the 'Free rooms' heading; line 448 summary repeats when and people but adds the chosen room at the Book button, serving the confirm step.
Headings 'Book a meeting room', 'Free rooms', 'Meeting details', 'Room booked' (lines 141, 185, 189, 549); no greetings, exclamation marks or congratulations in any string.
line 176 'Find rooms', line 205 'Book room', line 182 'Try again' (sits directly under the load error it retries), line 213 link 'Book another room'. All start with a specific verb.

line 268 maps feature codes to user words and durations read '1 hour 30 minutes', but line 537 shows the raw server id (e.g. 'bk_48213') as 'Booking reference'. First reading passed it as a user-facing reference, second reading failed it as an ID; verdicts differed.

line 385: 'Could not load rooms: the connection to the booking system dropped.' with Try again button; lines 510-512: 'Not booked: ... Try again.' / 'Untick catering or choose another room.' The raw ECONNRESET message is never shown.

lines 334-340, 382, 385, 488, 510-512: 'Enter a date.', 'That time has passed. Choose a later time.', 'Could not load rooms', 'Not booked'. No 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals.

line 395: 'No rooms are free on <when>, for <n> people. Try another time, a shorter meeting or fewer people.' shown directly under the search form whose fields and Find rooms button are the next step.

line 395: no-match state is a status line naming the criteria and what to change; lines 385-386: load failure is a separate alert 'Could not load rooms...' with a Try again button. Different text, region and action.

lines 377-388: failed search shows the error in the results position with Try again, form values untouched; lines 503-514: failed booking shows 'Not booked: ... Try again.' under Book room, fields and room selection kept, button re-enabled.

line 373: 'Looking for free rooms...' set before the await; line 499: 'Booking <room>...' set before the await; buttons get a busy style (lines 88, 351, 479). Calls last at most 1.5 seconds, so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 365-373: clearResults hides the results form and clears status before 'Looking for free rooms...' is shown; the empty text (line 395) and count (line 400) are only written after the response arrives.

lines 112, 130, 136: overflow-wrap anywhere and min-width 0 on room text, summary and dd; line 306 omits features when the list is empty; line 536 omits the note row when blank; rooms list is a single-column grid (93).

lines 465-474, 597-599: title, note and catering are written to sessionStorage on every input and reloaded in showForm (563); lines 392, 450: criteria and room are in the URL, so returning restores them.

No free-text format to guess: native date input with min set to today (148, 585), native time input (153), duration select (158-168), number input with min 1 (173). The only rules are self-evident and enforced by the controls; title has no format rule.

line 200 marks the note '(optional)' in words, but the required fields Date, Start time, Number of people and Meeting title (lines 148, 153, 173, 192) carry no required or aria-required attribute, so the attribute does not match the status.
lines 329-346, 487-491: validation runs only on submit; lines 589, 597: the input handlers only clear an existing error, never set one while typing.

lines 149, 154, 174, 193: each field has its own error paragraph directly below it, filled by setError (310-313); line 67 adds a thicker border via aria-invalid plus the bold text message, so not colour alone.
lines 345, 377-388, 487-491, 503-514: every rejection path only sets messages and focus; no field value is cleared or reset after a client or server rejection.

line 345: bad[0].focus() on a failed search submit; lines 489, 508, 383: focus moves to the title or start field; line 312 sets aria-invalid; lines 148, 153, 173, 192 tie each field to its message with aria-describedby.
lines 176, 205: both submit buttons are never disabled; lines 351, 479 set aria-disabled only while the request is in flight; submitting incomplete input shows field messages (334-340, 488).

line 483: book() returns at once if state.booking is set; line 363: search() does the same for state.searching; lines 479, 499: button gets aria-disabled busy styling and 'Booking <room>...' until the response.

lines 372-373 and 498-499: busy state and status text are set synchronously before the await; validation errors are written synchronously (341, 488); room radios show checked styling immediately (106-110).
lines 527-552: success switches to a 'Room booked' view listing room, time, people, title, catering and reference; lines 385, 510-512: failures state 'Could not load rooms' or 'Not booked'.
No toasts or success banners. The only success output is the 'Room booked' view (lines 527-552), which is the result itself and the only place the booking is visible.

lines 181, 207, 149-193: errors are written into in-place paragraphs with no timers; there is no setTimeout outside the simulated server. They clear only on retry, a new search or correction (357, 449, 589).
The interface has no remove, archive, move or change action on existing things; it only searches and creates a booking (lines 362, 482).
No action deletes or overwrites data, sends something unrecallable or spends money; the only write is creating a room booking (line 502).
No confirmation dialogs: no dialog element, confirm() call or modal anywhere in the file.
No optimistic updates: the booked view is shown only after createBooking resolves (lines 502, 516-523).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
lines 141-177: the page opens on the heading and the when/duration/people form with a primary Find rooms button; results and details follow below in task order (184-208).
line 141 heading is followed immediately by the search form at line 144; no hero, greeting or introductory panel.
The only summary number is the free-room count at line 400 ('3 rooms are free on ...'), which tells the user how many options match before picking one. No stat cards or charts.

line 400: count line states the number of rooms and the criteria in text above the list; the criteria form stays visible above; lines 453-462: editing a criterion hides the stale list. No unfiltered state exists for a clear-all to return to.

All controls are native: inputs, select, checkbox, radio inputs inside labels (lines 420-429), buttons and a link. Buttons use aria-disabled rather than disabled so they stay focusable (351, 479). No click-only custom widgets.

Selection is a checked native radio as well as the tinted border (106-111); errors have text and a thicker border (67, 69); the unavailable catering option is a disabled checkbox with an explanatory note (446-447).

lines 179-181, 197, 206-207: role=status and role=alert regions exist in the page from load and are filled later; line 415 announces the result count through sr-status; field errors come with a focus move (345, 489); line 551 focuses the h1.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only popup is a native select (line 158).

lines 39-47: the when grid is one column below 36rem; inputs are width 100% with 44px minimum height (53-64); room labels wrap (112); dl stacks below 30rem (133-134); main has 1rem side padding (32). No fixed widths over 375px.
